### CVE-2002-0499
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2002-06-11 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 21353: Linux Kernel 2.2.x/2.3/2.4.x - 'd_path()' Path Truncation (local/linux, 2002-03-26, verified=1)

The d_path function in Linux kernel 2.2.20 and earlier, and 2.4.18 and earlier, truncates long pathnames without generating an error, which could allow local users to force programs to perform inappropriate operations on the wrong directories.

### CVE-2002-1380
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2004-09-01 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 22105: Linux Kernel 2.2 - 'mmap()' Local Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2002-12-17, verified=1)

Linux kernel 2.2.x allows local users to cause a denial of service (crash) by using the mmap() function with a PROT_READ parameter to access non-readable memory pages through the /proc/pid/mem interface.

### CVE-2002-1826
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2005-06-28 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 21458: Grsecurity Kernel Patch 1.9.4 (Linux Kernel) - Memory Protection (local/linux, 2002-05-17, verified=1)

grsecurity 1.9.4 for Linux kernel 2.4.18 allows local users to bypass read-only permissions by using mmap to directly map /dev/mem or /dev/kmem to kernel memory.
